name: Follow-Up Bot
tagline: Drafts warm follow-up emails and DMs for the contacts you meet at events
description: After a conference or a busy event week, hand it the contacts you collected and it drafts a personal follow-up for each one, by email or X direct message. Nothing goes out until you approve the wording. If a thread sits unanswered for a while, it nudges you with a short list of conversations worth picking back up.
author: day__bliss
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
